items.text: Finished images are delivered within six working days of a shoot.
Retouching goes to Rosa, booked in whole days, at six finished images a day.
Harwood Gin's brief: photograph their 4 new bottles for the spring catalogue, each as a cut-out on white and in two styled scenes, at their Leeds distillery on Thursday 17 September.
Rosa is free for retouching every weekday from 21 September to 2 October.
Lens & Light hire a white paper backdrop with two strip softboxes at 85 a day.
The Premier Inn by Leeds station has rooms at 79 on Wednesday 16 September.
Shoot at the Leeds distillery on Thursday 17 September and stay at the Premier Inn the night before.
Hire the white backdrop and softboxes from Lens & Light for the cut-outs.
Shot list: each bottle as a cut-out on white and in two styled scenes, 12 set-ups in all.
Deliver two finished images per set-up, 24 in all, by Friday 25 September.
Book Rosa for four days, Monday 21 to Thursday 24 September, to retouch the 24 images.
Once Rosa's days are confirmed, send her the shot list and Harwood's colour notes.
Fen wants the styled scenes shot in front of the distillery's copper still.
Shoot the styled scenes in front of the copper still, dressed with juniper and lemon.
Olu's 100 mm macro lens is back from its service.
A couple, the Okekes, have asked for a quote for their wedding on Saturday 12 December.
Rail strikes are called on Northern routes for Saturday 3 October.
Olu's portfolio website renewal is due on 30 September.
Renew the portfolio website by 30 September.
Drive to Leeds on Wednesday 16 September with the hired lighting kit rather than take the train.
Fen will be at the shoot from 10:00 to sign off each set-up as it is done.
Lens & Light close at 17:30 on weekdays.
Collect the Lens & Light kit before 17:30 on Wednesday 16 September.
The studio dehumidifier needs a new filter.

task.text: Rosa wants the Harwood retouching confirmed today: how many images and which days. Book her.

18 finished images (two per set-up), still by Friday 25 September.

truth.why: One bottle fewer means 9 set-ups instead of 12 (D3), so two images per set-up gives 18 finished images, not 24 (D4), and at six a day Rosa needs three days, not four (D5). The shoot date, distillery and hotel (D1) and the backdrop hire (D2) cite the brief only for date, place and the white cut-outs, which are unchanged, and the delivery date stays Friday 25 September. Option b updates the image count but keeps Rosa's old four days.
